title: Test run.
officialText:
All new chimneys shall be test run under operating conditions to demonstrate fire safety and the complete
exhausting of smoke and the products of combustion to the outer air. The test run shall be conducted by a registered design
professional responsible for the test, and the results of such test run shall be certified as correct by such professional and submitted
in writing to the department.
